card.name: Dextrose strength digit before percent
card.fires_on: The digit 5 (or 0 in 50%) that starts a dextrose concentration, as in a list of compatible intravenous fluids. Also fires on a few odd spots such as 'as' in 'known as argyria'.

modes.label: Dextrose percent digit
modes.description: The number 5 or 50 right before % Dextrose Injection in lists of diluents.
modes.example: 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP <<5>>% Dextrose Injection, USP

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Isolated cases such as the word 'as' before a disease name or a partway-through-name piece in a proper name.
modes.example: producing a slate-blue discoloration of the skin known<< as>> argyria.
